random_variation: mean, sample SD, min, max across all fixed seeds; not a confidence interval
random_inputs: same uniform draws, per fold and seed on a stable record order, shared by models and conditions; no label or fault input
legacy_E_G: use saved margin80 / risk80 and pass masks, previous detector threshold 0.5; E/Z recompute from stored model, gate and training cut because that table omitted Z
HI_family: existing decision_score/threshold preserved. margin priority = 1/(1+abs(score-threshold)); proposed priority = margin priority + 1 for disagreement with a prespecified peer. Larger priority is reviewed first. Peer is H for A0/A1 and A1 for H/I. This is an untrained adaptation of the existing disagreement rule, not the E/G risk estimator.
HI_fixed: clean inner training-group OOF priority quantile(.8) for each fold, reused for every condition; pass if priority<=cut
matched: partition by the stored outer fold within each separate 480-window test run, pass lowest 96 priorities out of 120; no condition or truth is a policy input; offline comparison only
random_fixed: independent uniform score <= .8, actual count reported
primary_comparison: same detector, same original decisions, same coverage; no held output is a corrected diagnosis. Report TP_pass,FN_pass,FP_pass,H_TP,H_FN, hold burden, subgroup coverage and count denominators. No field safety inference.
